purpose: Small real-task quality/cost sweep, not a controlled causal benchmark
provider: personal profile cloud/openai-chatgpt/gpt-6-astra/medium; verify each manifest

questions.prompt: Explain how permission grants work here. Read the code, cite the files, and do not modify anything.
Explain why checkpoints do not prevent agents working in separate Git worktrees, and what remains unsafe. Read the code, cite the files, and do not modify anything.
Where is the default system prompt assembled, and where is proportional planning guidance added? Give the functions and files. Read the code and do not modify anything.
Where do /permissions reset and /permissions revoke take effect, and what do the grant usage counts mean? Cite the code and do not modify anything.
A hook denies a turn before model dispatch, yet completion says one loop turn and zero model requests. Is that expected? Trace the relevant code and do not modify anything.
A long answer table becomes labelled rows rather than a grid. Why does that happen, and is any text lost? Trace the relevant code and do not modify anything.

rubric.factualCoverage: 0 wrong central claim; 1 material omission; 2 essentials correct
rubric.proportionality: proportionate/overlong/too terse; words descriptive only, no hard cap

decision: At most one targeted change if a repeated material issue appears. Prioritize correctness; otherwise consider answer verbosity only when multiple narrow lookups/diagnoses contain unnecessary tutorials/repetition. At most three confirmation queries after a change; retain all failed attempts.
implementation: Fresh worktree: seed > as >= in markdownTable natural-width fit check. Ask agent to fix exactly-fit behavior, add packages/cli/test/eval-table-boundary.test.ts and run existing/new tests. Permit cwd write and only literal targeted pnpm test command. Pin existing test hash externally; require no unrelated tracked changes; independently run original regression and new tests; restore faulty condition temporarily to verify new test fails. Do not land trial artifact as a production fix; seed absent in main.
